name: Healthchecks
description: Healthchecks is a watchdog for your cron jobs. It's a web server that listens for pings from your cron jobs, plus a web interface.
short_desc: Healthchecks is a watchdog for your cron jobs
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: SECRET_KEY
form_fields.hint: A secret key used for cryptographic signing. Will generate a random value if one is not supplied and save it to /config/localsettings.py.

form_fields.label: SITE_ROOT
form_fields.hint: The site's top-level URL and the port it listens to if different than 80 or 443 (e.g., https://healthchecks.example.com:8000).

form_fields.label: ALLOWED_HOSTS
form_fields.hint: A comma-separated list of valid hostnames for the server. Default is the domain portion of SITEROOT.

form_fields.label: APPRISE_ENABLED
form_fields.hint: Set to True to enable the Apprise integration (https://github.com/caronc/apprise).

form_fields.label: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
form_fields.hint: A list of trusted origins for unsafe requests (e.g. POST). Defaults to the value of SITEROOT.

form_fields.label: DEBUG
form_fields.hint: Set to False to disable. Debug mode relaxes CSRF protections and increases logging verbosity but should be disabled for production instances as it will impact performance and security.

form_fields.label: EMAIL_USE_TLS
form_fields.hint: Use TLS for SMTP (True or False).

form_fields.label: INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS
form_fields.hint: Defaults to False. Set to True to allow integrations to connect to private IP addresses.

form_fields.label: PING_EMAIL_DOMAIN
form_fields.hint: The domain to use for generating ping email addresses. Defaults to localhost.

form_fields.label: RP_ID
form_fields.hint: If using webauthn for 2FA set this to match your Healthchecks domain. Webauthn will only work over https.

form_fields.label: SITE_LOGO_URL
form_fields.hint: Full URL to custom site logo.
